description: Research software and saved experiments for malicious URL screening with a CNN-LSTM, comparative baselines, rule annotations and tamper-evident logging. The positive class combines phishing, malware and defacement. Ghana-specific performance and production readiness are not established. MIT applies only to original project software and associated software documentation; datasets, model weights, manuscripts and third-party components are excluded from that licence grant. See LICENSE_SCOPE.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. DomURLs-BERT weights, tokenizer assets, notebook and selected integration code are intentionally withheld pending redistribution review. The archive does not support complete reproduction of every experiment.
